name: termux-elite
description: Portable operational skills for agents working inside Termux and Android environments.

skills.name: termux-environment
skills.description: Detect native Termux, Android, architecture, tools, storage and resource constraints.

skills.name: python-native-build
skills.description: Diagnose Python installs that need native libraries, compilers, Rust or unavailable wheels.

skills.name: package-troubleshooting
skills.description: Choose pkg versus apt, repair repository metadata and separate package from build failures.

skills.name: storage-permissions
skills.description: Diagnose Android shared-storage access and Termux permission boundaries.

skills.name: proot-boundaries
skills.description: Determine whether a failure belongs to native Termux or a proot distro and choose the right package boundary.

skills.name: github-actions
skills.description: Investigate failed GitHub Actions runs from local repositories without exposing credentials.

skills.name: termux-api
skills.description: Determine whether Termux:API is installed, matched, and permitted before relying on termux-* commands.

skills.name: background-processes
skills.description: Diagnose long-running processes that Android suspends or kills and choose the smallest mitigation.

skills.name: git-credentials
skills.description: Diagnose git clone and push authentication from Termux without exposing tokens or private keys.
